record.paper_title: Some open problems on the classical function space L1
record.original_question: Does there exist a closed bounded convex subset B of L1[0,1] that is anti-proximinal, meaning that every point x in L1[0,1]\B has no nearest point in B? If such a set exists, can one choose B to have nonempty interior?

evidence.quote: Problem 1. Does there exist an anti-proximinal closed bounded convex subset B in L1? What if we assume int (B) 6= ∅?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $L^1[0,1]$ denote the Banach space of (equivalence classes of) Lebesgue integrable real-valued functions on $[0,1]$, equipped with the norm $\|f\|_1=\int_0^1 |f(t)|\,dt$. For a nonempty subset $B\subseteq L^1[0,1]$ and a point $x\in L^1[0,1]$, a nearest point to $x$ in $B$ is an element $b_0\in B$ such that $\|x-b_0\|_1=\inf_{b\in B}\|x-b\|_1$. The set $B$ is called anti-proximinal if for every $x\in L^1[0,1]\setminus B$ there is no nearest point to $x$ in $B$.

(a) Does there exist a closed, bounded, convex subset $B\subseteq L^1[0,1]$ that is anti-proximinal?

(b) If such a set exists, can it be chosen so that its interior (with respect to the $\|\cdot\|_1$-norm topology) is nonempty?
artifact.status_search_result: Closed bounded convex anti-proximinal bodies have been constructed in spaces such as $c_0$ (with Day's norm), $C(T,E)$, $C_0(T)$, $L^\infty$, and $B(S)$, and Banach spaces with the Radon–Nikodym property are known to contain no such sets. However, web searches did not turn up a definitive construction or impossibility proof for closed bounded convex anti-proximinal subsets of $L^1[0,1]$, and in particular for the case of nonempty interior. The problem appears to remain unresolved in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: Antiproximinal Norms in Banach Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Closed convex bounded antiproximinal bodies are constructed in the infinite-dimensional spaces C(Q), C0(T), L∞(S,Σ,μ), and B(S).
status_evidence.claim: Constructions of closed bounded convex anti-proximinal bodies are known in C(Q), C0(T), L∞ and B(S), but the listed spaces do not include L1.

status_evidence.title: The n-antiproximinal sets
status_evidence.snippet: The existence of convex closed n-antiproximinal sets in the spaces C and L1 is studied.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of (n-)antiproximinal convex closed sets in L1 has been investigated, indicating the question is active and not trivially settled.

status_evidence.title: Antiproximinal sets in some Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: There are no closed bounded antiproximinal sets in Banach spaces with the Radon–Nikodym property.
status_evidence.claim: The standard obstruction (RNP) does not apply to L1[0,1], so it does not immediately rule out anti-proximinal closed bounded convex subsets of L1[0,1].
